name: side mountain climber
description: A mountain climber where the knees drive toward the elbows on the side. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques and hips.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow.
Return that foot and switch quickly to the other leg.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Continue at a brisk pace for the set time.
